notes.subject: ילע
notes.rationale: 'em i autim tok stret' (ASV/JPS, rashly declare) o 'em i kaikai' (KJV/Geneva, devoureth); mi bihainim ASV/JPS.

notes.subject: לבקר
notes.rationale: ם namba 'i go skelim' — tok i minim 'monsing i kamap' o 'rausim malolo', hia em i minim 'rausim malolo' olsem toktok bilong ol man.

notes.subject: ילע
notes.rationale: ם namba 'em i autim tok' i save wokim wanpela taim tasol long olgeta Tanakh.

translation: Moket bilong man: em i autim tok stret olsem 'samting i holi', na bihain long ol neder i go skelim.
